ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated in the central-lower lobes against 35% low-intensity black pixels along the trailing edges and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions in the central-ventral areas of both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and median notch. Distinct small-scale black mottling and circular spots are scattered within the white fields, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees; notch depth is distinct and symmetrical.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary. Serrations exhibit variable pixel-amplitudes, appearing more jagged and irregular on the distal thirds of both lobes compared to the regions near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp, textured upward sweep at the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, off-white textured pixels (barnacle colonies) located on the outer distal tips and leading edges. Several small circular white spots are visible against the black trailing edge pigmentation of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; numerous small circular depigmented scars (potential barnacle attachment sites) located in the black pigmentation zones of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'ragged' texture on the outer fluke tips caused by a combination of natural serration and biological encrustation.
